Generated by `modelspec-docs` from `cargo metadata --no-deps`: every package of the workspace, with the `description` its `Cargo.toml` gives. There are 6 packages. None is on a registry; the [0.25.0 release](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/releases/tag/0.25.0) ships the `modelspec` binary.

## The compiler and its runtime

`modelspec-core` carries no Vulkan dependency, and `task core-no-vulkan` fails when one appears in its dependency tree (DESIGN.md § 7).

| Package | Directory | In Rust | Depends on | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `modelspec-cli` | [`crates/modelspec-cli`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/tree/main/crates/modelspec-cli) | `use modelspec_cli`, binary `modelspec` | `modelspec-core`, `modelspec-observatory`, `modelspec-runtime` | The modelspec command-line interface |
| `modelspec-core` | [`crates/modelspec-core`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/tree/main/crates/modelspec-core) | `use modelspec_core` | none | The ModelSpec compiler: parsing, checking, IR and autodiff, without Vulkan |
| `modelspec-diagram` | [`crates/modelspec-diagram`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/tree/main/crates/modelspec-diagram) | `use modelspec_diagram` | `modelspec-core` | Architecture diagrams of ModelSpec programs: the glyph set, one SVG symbol per Tensor IR operation, themed by CSS custom properties |
| `modelspec-observatory` | [`crates/modelspec-observatory`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/tree/main/crates/modelspec-observatory) | `use modelspec_observatory`, binary `modelspec-ui-types` | none | The training observatory: the typed RunEvents of a training run and their live Server-Sent Events stream |
| `modelspec-runtime` | [`crates/modelspec-runtime`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/tree/main/crates/modelspec-runtime) | `use modelspec_runtime` | `modelspec-core` | The ModelSpec runtime: CPU oracle interpreter and training loop |

## Repository tooling

Generators and checks the repository's own gate runs. Nothing outside the repository depends on them.

| Package | Directory | In Rust | Depends on | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `modelspec-docs` | [`crates/modelspec-docs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/tree/main/crates/modelspec-docs) | binary `modelspec-docs` | `modelspec-cli`, `modelspec-core`, `modelspec-diagram`, `modelspec-runtime` | Generates and checks the derived pages of the ModelSpec documentation site. |
